protocol: Same optimizer, 120 steps and batch of 128 as the first trial. The replacement positions sample labeled TACO glass and plastic with equal probability. Out-of-fold predictions use source-batch groups and exclude near neighbors from training. The final checkpoint learns from all development crops, evaluated on TrashNet val.

selection.tie_break: Highest mean development balanced recall; ties prefer fewer external samples

holdout.checks: Mean recall for each observed label must be at least as high as original. Same recipes and checkpoints for all rows. No reselection.
